values.meaning: critical strike damage modifier applied to Flair's damage
values.quote: can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage

mechanics.claim: Flair fires a shot at the first enemy hit, or slashes in melee range, dealing the same damage either way.
mechanics.quote: fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: In melee range Samira slashes in a cone instead, applying area damage rather than the shot's spell damage.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on the shot and {{tip|area damage}} on the slash and explosives.

mechanics.claim: The slash and explosives roll critical strikes separately against each target hit.
mechanics.quote: The slash and explosives roll their {{tip|critical strike}} against each target individually.

mechanics.claim: The shot and slash count as the same ability cast for the purposes of Style stacking.
mechanics.quote: The shot and the slash do not count as different abilities for stacking {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style}}.

mechanics.claim: Cast during Wild Rush, Flair instead deploys explosives that detonate at the end of the dash, dealing the same damage.
mechanics.quote: deploys explosives in her wake that detonate upon the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins on cast, not on effect landing.
The ability fires/slashes from Samira's position at the end of the cast time, not where she was at cast start.
mechanics.quote: ''Flair'' will fire or slash from wherever '''Samira''' is at the end of the cast time.
